title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel is shocked by Kumar's revelation about Saravanan's promise to help him marry Arasi. Saravanan then apologises to the family, explaining the reason behind his actions.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan eases Nila's anger over his late arrival after securing an advance for the house. Later, he consoles his brothers as Cheran breaks the news that they must move.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Seetha breaks down as she tells Muthu that Arun harassed her for speaking to Meena over the phone. Furious, Muthu and Meena take Seetha to Chandhra's home, ensuring her safety.

title: Neeya Naana
episodeTitle: Gen Z vs Traditional Work Ethics
description: Contrasting work ethics fuel intense debate as Gen Z employee expectations challenge conventional views. Tune in as compelling arguments spark curiosity, leading to resolution.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Seniors honour the legendary singer with flawless acts, magical duets and buzzers. Standing ovations follow, while judges and guests team up for memorable musical mashups.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: An impressive cooking battle celebrates treats from Kurinji, Mullai, Neithal, and Marudham lands. Great anticipation builds as cooks present regional flavours with pride.
